An '''Overload Dispersal Grid''' was a component used in [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] such as [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolaser]]. The Grid was located in the moveable turret, close to the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the weapon.<ref name="EGWT" />
